entities.entity_name: Research on a Multi-Stage Data Augmentation Framework for Event Extraction
entities.description: This section introduces the research focus on developing a multi-stage data augmentation framework specifically designed for event extraction tasks, as part of the broader research on event extraction frameworks.
Refers to the core challenge of identifying and extracting events from text, which is the central theme of this section.
Describes the process of enhancing data through multiple stages to improve the performance of event extraction models.
